tool_args.rationale: The five pilot observations are confined to short horizons, while the target horizon is 22.2 and the supplied mechanism predicts a sign reversal around H=15–25. Acquire the slow-horizon discriminating probe before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the sink-coupled dual-horizon reversal law from the five short-horizon rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All rows have H ≤ 0.48, so they cannot identify the long-horizon reversal or calibrate adaptation for the target H=22.2.
More fine-grained observations at short horizons would not resolve the key long-horizon ambiguity.
It is not relevant to distinguishing the candidate temporal mechanisms.
